declarations.rationale: Take/control/win-control/gain-control dominate with political parties to chambers and sovereignty-to-territory roles; corporate control is separate.
Tell and notify supply13 of26 rows, with say-to reinforcement. Minister/coach and other contextual roles are separate.
Win/capture/champion/event-victory paths dominate with team-to-competition arguments; mere reach is excluded.
Live/living/life-in and exile-in dominate, with people/populations to places. Death/work/travel alone are excluded.
Include and led-by paths with parties/teams to named people form the dominant membership family after role inspection. Geographic containment is a competing meaning, not included in the predicate.
Captain/guard/player and play-with paths identify athlete-to-team representation. Coach-to-player interactions in give/say/bench paths are distinct and do not qualify.
Possessive lawyer/counsel appositives and defended-by paths dominate, ordered client to attorney; crossed-examination/reporting attachments require scrutiny.
Win/champion/retain-title/championship/title-defense dominate, ordered boxer/team to sporting championship; election to political office is distinct.

Nineteen rows link NBC or NBC News to program constructions containing meet-Press, identifying broadcaster-to-program affiliation; Press is a truncated title requiring scrutiny. East-to-West interaction is contamination.
Withdraw/withdrawal/pullout/driven-out/completed-withdrawal form the dominant geographic departure family, exceeding invasion/attack. Arrival or invasion alone is not departure.
Executive possessive/in/nominal and unseated/sworn-as-executive paths form the dominant specific office; deanship/teaching/manager alone is excluded.
Chief, president, executive and director form a genuinely mixed formal-office family. Founder and partner alone do not qualify.
Live-in supplies9 rows and forms the dominant identifiable family; travel, killing and authorship are separate.

Go-to and arrive-in form9 destination-movement rows; event-win/competition is a comparably sized competing family. The highest individual interpretable path is go-to(7), giving the declared tie-break to geographic travel; event destinations remain excluded.
Executive-title and taking-office paths dominate, mostly county executive roles; running for office alone does not establish tenure.

Bring-to/flee-to/arrive-in identify directional movement(7 rows), tied with have/keep/put-in presence(7); the highest individual path bring-to(5) gives the predefined tie-break to travel. Political presidency and mere presence remain distinct.
Ask/persuade/call dominate over resignation from leadership and sports paths.
Write-in, critic-of/for and review-for form a coherent publication-contributor family. Say-in alone does not establish authorship.
Go-to and return-to dominate over secretary and production-role paths; physical movement remains distinct from office or theatrical metonymy.
Win/title and led-to event paths dominate with team/boxer/horse-to-championship roles; mere entry or loss is not winning.
